The Australia scope fixtures are bounded captures of the local 22 October 2026
build (Cricsheet archive through 14 October 2026). They retain Australian season
rows and their referenced players, with column indices remapped consistently.
Selection references are deliberately Australia-only in these network-free tests.
They are regression evidence, not a replacement for the site's global reference
population. Tests check season-row cutoffs; embedded priors and static biography
flags retain the build's documented whole-archive methodology.

`australia-t20i-renshaw-swap.json` captures the exact scored solver input from the
reported Renshaw-for-Green freeze, independently compared with a MILP optimum.
